## What lives here
The application source: routes (pages), components, API clients, zustand stores, the shared libraries and the types.

## Conventions
Path alias `@/` → `src/`. Strict TypeScript (`exactOptionalPropertyTypes`, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`).

## Entry points
`router.tsx`, `server.ts` and `start.ts`.
